propositions: The tests overlay is currently selected only by glob matching changed test files, missing cases where source-only changes add new declarations without corresponding tests

A content-based trigger must detect added function/class/method declarations (via existing polyglot regex) whose names are not also removed in the same file, excluding docs/config changes and test-file changes

The detector receives composed diff context (truncated at 60000 chars) plus the changed_files list from the workflow step, requiring a new keyword-only parameter to pass changed_files into content_triggered_overlays

Guard (vii) in the prompt must distinguish newly-introduced behavior (implemented by added lines) from pre-existing behavior reachable only through unadded lines, and require named concrete violating inputs
The trigger mechanism must be portable across languages and layouts (Go, Rust, TypeScript, Ruby) and must fail closed on anonymous declarations or annotation-only rewrites
